title: Minimum credit score
content: Conforming conventional loans require a minimum representative FICO credit score of 680. Applications with a score below 680 must be referred to a human underwriter. Scores of 740 and above qualify for the best pricing tier.

title: Debt-to-income (DTI) limit
content: The maximum allowable back-end debt-to-income (DTI) ratio for a Qualified Mortgage (QM) is 43 percent. Applications with a DTI above 0.43 must be referred to an underwriter. DTI is monthly debt obligations divided by gross monthly income.

title: Loan-to-value and PMI
content: Loan-to-value (LTV) is the loan amount divided by the appraised property value. When LTV exceeds 80 percent, private mortgage insurance (PMI) is required as a condition of approval. LTV at or below 80 percent does not require PMI.

title: Standard documentation requirements
content: Standard income and asset documentation includes: two most recent pay stubs, W-2 forms for the past two years, and two to three months of bank statements. Any missing document must be listed as an approval condition.

title: Self-employed documentation
content: Self-employed borrowers must provide two years of personal (and, if applicable, business) tax returns and a year-to-date profit and loss statement. A CPA letter confirming continued business viability strengthens the file.

title: Gift funds
content: Gift funds used toward down payment or closing costs require a signed gift letter stating the amount, the donor relationship, and that no repayment is expected. Large or unusual deposits require a written explanation and sourcing.

title: TRID disclosure timing
content: Under TRID (TILA-RESPA Integrated Disclosure), the Loan Estimate must be delivered to the borrower within three business days of application. The Closing Disclosure must be received at least three business days before consummation.

title: Employment verification
content: A two-year employment history is expected. Employment must be verified prior to closing. Gaps or a pending verification should be noted as a condition. Recently changed jobs within the same field are generally acceptable.

title: Decision matrix
content: Approve (conditional) when credit is at least 680, DTI is at most 0.43, and any missing documents are listed as conditions. Add PMI as a condition when LTV exceeds 80 percent. Refer to underwriter when credit is below 680 or DTI exceeds 0.43.
